Static Architecture Analysis -- CLI-driven TypeScript analysis subsystem
|-- [M] Modular structure -- semantic components, boundaries and dependencies
|   |-- Analysis contract
|   |   |-- StaticAnalyzer.analyze(request) -> Promise<StaticAnalysisResult>
|   |   |-- Request: repository + tsconfig + selected paths + views + frameworks + metric settings
|   |   |   `-- Selection limits emitted facts; imports may still support symbol resolution
|   |   `-- Result: AnalysisArtifact + measurements + semantic-resolution execution flag
|   |-- Extraction engine implements StaticAnalyzer
|   |   |-- Coordinates declarations, lexical references, resources, calls and dataflow
|   |   |-- Framework extraction: React, Zustand, tldraw and controller relationships
|   |   `-- Depends on AnalysisContext for compiler access, identities, facts and provenance
|   |-- Incremental session wraps an injectable StaticAnalyzer
|   |   |-- Exposes analyze(), exportCheckpoint() and restoreCheckpoint()
|   |   `-- Keeps fragment cache and update coordination private
|   |-- Domain analysis and persistence
|   |   |-- Schema defines the shared artifact contract
|   |   |-- deriveAnalysis consumes facts -> partitions, metrics, SCCs, findings and a tree
|   |   `-- Persistence exposes validation, parsing and canonical serialization
|   |-- CLI composes extraction + persistence + architecture reporting
|   |   `-- Separate subsystem; supplied evidence establishes no browser generation stage
|   `-- Structural evidence combines containment and lexical scope conceptually
|       |-- Imports/reexports + exported metadata retain component dependency and exposure facts
|       |-- Declarations/references/captures retain visibility and access relationships
|       |-- Layer, feature and composition-root metadata support higher-level grouping
|       |   `-- sourceClassification is shared with architecture boundary classification
|       `-- Stored schema still uses separate containment and lexical views
|-- [C] Invocation flow -- execution of the analyzer, distinct from calls it analyzes
|   |-- CLI entry
|   |   |-- Read tsconfig -> select TS/TSX files -> apply optional path prefixes
|   |   `-- Await staticAnalyzer.analyze() with all views and four framework families
|   |-- staticAnalyzer.analyze(request)
|   |   |-- Create AnalysisContext + Declarations
|   |   |-- declarations.index() -> imports() -> composition()
|   |   |-- Any requested view beyond containment? -> extractLexical()
|   |   |-- Calls, ownership or dependencies requested?
|   |   |   |-- Resources.initialize() -> extractCalls() -> extractFrameworks()
|   |   |   `-- Ownership or dependencies requested?
|   |   |       `-- prepareDataflow() -> releaseCompiler() -> extractDataflow()
|   |   |           `-- connectCallbackCandidates()
|   |   `-- context.finish() -> release working state -> deriveAnalysis() -> return result
|   |-- CLI awaits result -> serializes artifact -> writes report -> writes run manifest
|   |   `-- Artifact stream: canonical JSON -> gzip -> temporary file -> rename
|   `-- Calls recorded about the analyzed program are static evidence
|       |-- Contract represents calls/construction, callback registration and scheduling
|       |-- Dispatch and provenance distinguish resolution, inference and uncertainty
|       `-- Actual activation-to-activation history is not produced by this pipeline
|           `-- Runtime identities are reserved; observed facts require runtime-probe provenance
|-- [O] Ownership -- working memory, reusable fragments and output lifetimes
|   |-- AnalysisContext owns per-run compiler and fact-building state
|   |   |-- Starts with a syntax program; first checker access builds semantic resolution
|   |   |-- Accumulates entity/relation maps, AST associations and source ranges
|   |   |-- releaseCompiler() pins compiler inputs before dropping program/checker references
|   |   `-- finish() materializes fact arrays; release() clears working collections
|   |       `-- Returned artifact survives cleanup and is then enriched by deriveAnalysis()
|   |-- Module-level previousProgram retains reusable compiler state for small selections
|   |   `-- Selections over 100 files disable prior-program retention for the large run
|   |-- IncrementalAnalyzer owns a session checkpoint of reusable component fragments
|   |   |-- busy guard rejects concurrent updates and checkpoint restoration during a run
|   |   |   `-- analyze() resets busy in finally, including failure
|   |   |-- Export clones the checkpoint; restore validates then clones incoming state
|   |   |-- Cache hit -> retain fragment; cache miss -> await injected extractor
|   |   `-- Replace checkpoint only after complete assembly and derivation succeed
|   |       `-- Failed update leaves the previously published checkpoint in place
|   |-- CLI owns output publication
|   |   |-- Gzip temporary file is removed in finally after pipeline/rename attempt
|   |   `-- Report and manifest each use temporary-file rename for publication
|   `-- Ownership facts about analyzed code are separate from these analyzer lifetimes
|       `-- Contract records creation, retention, aliases, mutation capability and disposal
`-- [D] Data dependency -- what each result needs, independent of organizational grouping
    |-- Reproducible artifact [shared A]
    |   |-- Extracted entities + relations + uncertainties
    |   |-- Snapshot: source/configuration hashes + compiler/analyzer versions + scope
    |   |   `-- Git commit and relevant dirty inputs when available
    |   |-- Every fact carries evidence status, method and pinned source locations
    |   |   `-- UTF-16 offsets, file hash and snapshot identity preserve source correspondence
    |   `-- Coverage derives from facts and uncertainties, including partial/not-run views
    |-- Derived architecture needs [shared A] + partition settings + shuffle settings
    |   |-- Universe: selected source entities, excluding structural/type/external categories
    |   |-- Groupings: directory, source layer or one group containing all source entities
    |   |-- Graph layers select resolved/inferred relations
    |   |   |-- Calls: calls + constructs
    |   |   |-- Data: value-flow + argument + return + reads + writes
    |   |   |-- State: reads + writes
    |   |   `-- Reactive: reactive + selects + prop-flow + context-read + effect-dependency
    |   |-- Partitions + graph layers -> cohesion, coverage and shuffled-baseline metrics
    |   |-- Participating graph endpoints -> strongly connected components -> condensation edges
    |   |   `-- Condensed edges retain original relation IDs as evidence
    |   `-- Facts -> investigative findings; contains relations -> canonical tree projection
    |-- Incremental reuse needs current dependency evidence, not just selected-file hashes
    |   |-- Fresh inventory: local contents + current import resolutions + environment inputs
    |   |-- Current import edges + still-relevant cached dependency edges -> component groups
    |   |-- Fragment key: environment + selected members + component hashes/resolutions
    |   |   |-- Matching key -> reuse cached facts
    |   |   `-- Different key -> extract that component's selected files again
    |   |-- Uncertain global effects -> broaden to one group of all inventoried local files
    |   |   `-- Includes global scripts, augmentations, dynamic resolution and declaration risks
    |   `-- Reused/new facts + fresh snapshot header -> merged artifact
    |       `-- Always recompute derived results, even when every fragment is reused
    `-- Published outputs share [shared A]
        |-- Validated artifact -> canonical JSON -> compressed analysis artifact
        |   `-- Checks include pinned ranges, valid references, tree/SCC integrity and metrics
        |-- Same artifact -> architecture report
        `-- Hashes + sizes + coverage + measurements + timestamp -> separate run manifest
            `-- Timing and RSS stay outside deterministic persisted analysis facts
